summary.text: Sharon Chung is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 91, in office since January 2023, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A professional violist and violinist from Bloomington, she was elected to the McLean County Board in 2018.

paragraphs.text: Sharon Chung was born in Chicago, Illinois, and lives in Bloomington, Illinois.

She earned a bachelor's degree from Illinois Wesleyan University in 2000 and a graduate degree from Northwestern University in 2003, and her career experience includes working as a professional violist and violinist.

According to her 2022 Ballotpedia survey responses, she was elected to the McLean County Board in 2018 to represent District 7 and has served on its Land Use and Development, Health, and Justice committees.
Chung assumed office in the Illinois House on January 11, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the Agriculture & Conservation, Appropriations-Higher Education, Economic Opportunity & Equity, Health Care Licenses, Museum, Arts, Culture, and Entertainment, and Veterans' Affairs committees, and as vice-chair of the House Higher Education Committee.
In the 2022 survey, she listed lowering costs for families, ending violence against women, and advocating for communities as her key campaign messages.
